applicabilityBasis.summary: GDLR represents a contractual redemption claim for 10 mg of fine physical gold whose value tracks the gold spot market rather than maintaining a fixed amount of national currency as required by the GENIUS Act payment-stablecoin definition.

genius.notes: Doma General Terms and Conditions v3.0 (effective 2026-11-13) identify Lumina Secure S.A. (Panama City, Republic of Panama) as issuer and KSTN Capital Ltd as group owner of the physical gold backing pool. The United States, UK, EU/EEA, UAE, and Panama are listed as Excluded Jurisdictions under reverse-solicitation terms. Because GDLR tracks 10 mg of physical gold rather than a fixed monetary value in national currency, GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization is not applicable. Doma publishes an on-chain proof-of-reserves dashboard and written redemption terms, but no independent monthly reserve-to-liability attestation reports are published.
